ideas.title: The Impact of Childcare Fraud on Local Communities
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of childcare fraud on local communities, including financial losses and erosion of trust.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of childcare fraud cases and their community impact
questions: What are the common schemes used in childcare fraud?
How can local communities prevent childcare fraud?
ideas.insight: Childcare fraud not only results in financial losses but also erodes trust in local institutions.

ideas.title: Investigating Deaths and Health Care Issues in ICE Detention Centers
ideas.description: Look into the causes of deaths and health care issues in ICE detention centers under the Trump administration.
ideas.angle: In-depth investigation into the systemic issues leading to deaths and health care problems
questions: What are the leading causes of death in ICE detention centers?
How can health care in detention centers be improved?
ideas.insight: Systemic issues in ICE detention centers require immediate attention and reform.
